content: SELECT DISTINCT c.CountryId, c.CountryName FROM countries c WHERE c.CountryId IN (SELECT cm.Country FROM car_makers cm GROUP BY cm.Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 UNION SELECT cm.Country FROM car_makers cm JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id WHERE lower(ml.Model) = 'fiat')
